preconditions.description: The length of the input string S is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '0123456789' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: Each character in the input string S is a digit from 0 to 9.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer.
The minimal number of jumps is between 0 and N-1 inclusive.
The output is the minimal number of jumps needed to reach the last digit from the first digit.
